design.scientific_question: Does predicting measured intervention realisation improve held-out intervention contrasts?

candidate_scope.background: PC9 EGFR-mutant NSCLC; availability and identity authentication unconfirmed
menu: non-targeting guide and matched delivery controls
candidate_scope.claim_domain: One background, unseen culture batches and registered conditions; no cross-lineage claim

cheap_inputs: decision-available cell count and growth/viability markers
design.optional_input: RNA only for a separately authenticated backend; not required by this design

measurements.realisation: Absolute phospho-EGFR relative to matched vehicle and loading control; retain total EGFR separately
measurements.proximal_function: Phospho-ERK with total/loading controls; pathway proxy, not unique mechanism proof
measurements.phenotype: ATP with vehicle, blank and independent cell-count control; fixed endpoint time pending
measurements.timing: Pilot fixes modality-specific preparation and matched comparison horizons; do not assume CRISPRi and drug onset equal

training_comparison.constrained: realisation_hat = f(cheap covariates, nominal intervention); phenotype = g(covariates, realisation_hat, modality)
training_comparison.leakage_guard: Measured post-action realisation is a training target. At decision time use predicted realisation; newly measured values enter only after a real feedback event
training_comparison.validation: Whole physical batches held out; development-only preprocessing, calibration, hyperparameters and contrast margins
outcomes: measured utility and refusal contribution if separately admitted
training_comparison.limitations: A supervised effect predictor does not identify causal mediation or mechanism-conditional likelihoods

two_round_feedback.round_1: Select a registered intervention/readout/time bundle under a frozen budget; commit exact plan and prediction identities
two_round_feedback.feedback: Import actual matched result/QC/failure/cost records; update only through the existing evidence admission authority
two_round_feedback.round_2: Choose registered orthogonal function/rescue evidence, additional measurement or stopping based on admitted results
two_round_feedback.likelihood_boundary: No numerical mechanism Bayes factors or information gain without separately validated hypothesis-conditional probabilities

blocking_unknowns: minimum meaningful gain and refusal loss
physical variance and confirmation sample size
stop_rules: Stop training until measurement identities, controls, units and raw provenance are audited
Stop this decision task if development action differences lack meaningful headroom
Modify the model if realised-action contrast prediction fails independent development validation
Promote no scientific default without frozen independent matched-budget confirmation
